Start: 1225-08-25  
17 weeks = 17 × 7 = 119 days.  
Total days to subtract = 119 + 5 = 124 days.  

1225-08-25 minus 124 days:  
August has 31 days.  
Go back 25 days to 1225-07-31.  
Remaining 124 - 25 = 99 days earlier.  
July has 31 days, June 30, May 31.  
From July 31 back 31 days → June 30.  
From June 30 back 30 days → May 31.  
Remaining 99 - 31 - 30 = 38 days earlier from May 31.  
April has 30 days → back 30 days to April 1.  
Remaining 38 - 30 = 8 days earlier from April 1 → March 24.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1225-03-24
